spots.name: George Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,916 m (9,567 ft).

spots.name: Lucin
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 134 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L269281.
